charts.title: fig05-executable-dynamics
charts.caption: Interactive Fig 5: a closed sense/act loop. Over 8 steps, uptake_flux climbs 0 → 0.34 as the cell draws down the local chemical bump, mechanical_field rises 0 → 0.94 and traction 0 → 0.41 as the cell acts back mechanically, and the cell's own shape/mass proxy grows (mass 1.0 → 1.17, shape 1.0 → 1.07). The cell depletes local nutrient, diffusion refills it — the cell reshapes the very gradient it depends on (niche construction); interface preserved (Law 2).
